prerequisites: Completion of the S7 systems engineering course

learning_outcomes.text: Understand the interest and importance of Validation and Verification in system development
Position validation and verification activities in the system engineering process
Differentiate between validation and verification activities
Distinguish between requirements V&V and system V&V activities
Distinguish between different models, and understand their uses and limitations in systems engineering.
Draw up test procedures for a system

syllabus_topics: Verification and validation of system and subsystem requirements
bibliography: Ingénierie des systèmes : analyse, modélisation et simulation des systèmes, Emmanuel HYGOUNENC, édition ISTE
Systems Engineering : analysis, Modeling and Simulation of Systems, Emmanuel HYGOUNENC, edition ISTE WILEY
degree: Titre d'ingénieur ENIT (cycle ingénieur, semestres 5-10; orientación mecánica/producción)
